annotations.title: Fill a DMR from monitoring rows

description: What numbers go on a permit's DMR this period, computed from the plant's own daily results? The numbers a US NPDES permit's Discharge Monitoring Report asks for in one period, computed from the plant's own raw results (daily samples, flows): for each value due on the period's forms (EPA's national limits file) its statistic as EPA defines it (monthly average, daily maximum, weekly average over EPA's Sunday-to-Saturday weeks, geometric mean, loadings in lb/d from concentration x flow x 8.34, percent removal), the rows it was computed from, and EPA's violation rule's verdict against the limit. A value the rows cannot give is refused with its code (fill.no_column, fill.unit, fill.ambiguous, dmr.nd_rule_missing ...): a number the rows do not hold is never supplied. Send `rows` as JSON (date, parameter, value, unit, point) or `table` as the file's text (a laboratory's long export, or a sheet of days with one column per parameter); include the previous month's last days when a weekly average is due. A result below detection enters an average by `nd_rule` (zero, half, dl, dl_lt), else by the state's written rule. `netdmr: true` adds the NetDMR "Import DMRs" file as text (not yet validated by NetDMR's own import check). The rows reach our server to be computed and are not kept: only how many rows were sent and values filled is counted.

nd_rule.description: How a result below detection enters an average: as zero, half the limit, the limit (dl), or the limit reported as less-than (dl_lt). Default: the state's written rule, else none (such a statistic is refused).

netdmr.description: Also return the NetDMR "Import DMRs" file (CSV text) for the values filled.

period_end.description: The reporting period: its month (2026-09) or its last day (2026-09-30).

permit.description: The NPDES permit number, e.g. PA0228061.

rows.description: The plant's results, one a row (send rows or table).

detection_limit.description: Optional: the detection or reporting limit of an ND result.

outfall.description: Optional: the outfall the sample belongs to, read with the point.

parameter.description: As the plant's log names it (TSS, CBOD5, Ammonia-N, Flow, pH, E. coli, Copper ...), or EPA's parameter code or name as get_permit prints them (01032; Chromium, hexavalent [as Cr]). A row whose parameter or date is not read is counted in `read.unread`.

point.description: Where it was sampled, as the plant names it: Influent, Effluent, Outfall 002 ...

value.description: The result: 12, or "<0.5" below detection, or "ND" with a detection_limit.

table.description: The plant's file as text (CSV, TSV or semicolons; at most 2000000 characters) or as lines of cells (send rows or table).

name: fill_dmr
title: Fill a DMR from monitoring rows
